general.dl: EA Nov 1 / RD Feb 15; 6-yr BS/MD by invitation after admission
general.note: One of only two active 6-year BS/MD programs in the country, with the friendliest published bar of any accelerated route (3.5 / 1300). Howard University Hospital and the College of Medicine sit on campus; the HBCU mission shapes the culture. Entry to the BS/MD is by invitation to admitted freshmen, and an MCAT 504 checkpoint gates the MD years.
general.medNote: At his stats the invitation is realistic; the question is whether DC and the mission fit are right for him.

accel.mcat: MCAT 504+ required inside the program (Phase II)
accel.apply: Admit to Howard via Common App; qualifying freshmen are INVITED in spring/summer before enrolling
accel.note: One of only two active 6-year programs. Entry bar (3.5 / 1300, 650 per section preferred) is the friendliest of all accelerated routes; the catch is invitation-only entry and an MCAT 504 checkpoint to advance. HBCU mission-driven; small cohort.
accel.why: At 3.67/1440 he clears the published 3.5/1300 bar comfortably — the most attainable accelerated MD on the board if he is open to DC and the invitation lands.
